How Long Is the Immigration Queue at Cam Ranh Airport in October 2026?

In October 2026, based on flight schedules and the airport’s published passenger numbers from 2024–2026, passengers landing during the busiest hours at Cam Ranh International Airport (CXR) could spend 54–83 minutes completing immigration procedures. With Fast Track, this time is under 15 minutes at any hour.

When Fast Track matters most

Flights landing 10:00–13:00 and 20:00–06:00, when arrivals from Seoul, Busan, Novosibirsk and Guangzhou land minutes apart. Land 16:00–20:00 — the line is shorter, though rarely short.

October 2026 notes

Nha Trang’s wettest month, but both winter markets are starting. Russian charters build through October, and from the 25th the winter schedule lands eleven Korean flights between 20:20 and 00:35 — the day’s heaviest stretch is late at night.

How we estimate: a minute-by-minute queue model over the 28 international arrivals on a representative October day, counting deplaning and the walk to the hall, and checked against the waits travellers report.

What We Offer

What Is Airport Fast Track?

Cam Ranh International Airport (CXR) — booked as Nha Trang in most systems — serves Bai Dai, Nha Trang, Ninh Van Bay and Vinh Hy. It is Vietnam’s only airport with more international than domestic passengers, and Terminal 2 has few immigration counters. Fast Track keeps you to 10–15 minutes, whatever the crowd.

Peak hours — CXR T2

When the Charters Land

A small terminal taking big aircraft. Two Russian wide-bodies within the hour, or the Korean evening flights back to back, and the T2 hall fills in minutes. In peak charter season the queue runs well over an hour.

Your name. Our sign.

We're Already Waiting

Our assistant is waiting before the immigration counters, holding a sign with your name. No guessing which line is which after an overnight flight.

Priority Lane — CXR T2

Through in 10–15 Minutes

Priority lane, paperwork handled, escorted out to arrivals. While the regular line is still building you are in the car — twenty minutes to Bai Dai, forty-five to Nha Trang.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before booking your Fast Track at Cam Ranh Airport. Still have questions? Chat with us on WhatsApp.

Yes. The airport serving Nha Trang is Cam Ranh International Airport (CXR), about 35 km south of the city. Airlines and booking sites list it as both "Nha Trang" and "Cam Ranh" — it is the same place. The old airfield inside Nha Trang city no longer handles passenger flights.

From CXR it's roughly 10–20 minutes to the Bai Dai resort strip, 40–50 minutes to central Nha Trang, and around an hour to Vinh Hy.

In October 2026, based on flight schedules and the airport’s published passenger numbers from 2024–2026, passengers landing during the busiest hours at Cam Ranh Airport could spend 54–83 minutes completing immigration procedures, and 28–30 minutes at quieter hours.

With Fast Track, this time is under 15 minutes at any hour. See the estimate for your landing time (updated 2 October 2026).

You must already have a valid entry document — one of the following:

› E-Visa (applied online in advance at evisa.gov.vn)
› Visa Exemption — Russia, Korea, Japan & EU 45 days; ASEAN 30 days
› Visa on Arrival approval letter (invitation-letter holders only)
› Temporary Residence Card
› APEC Business Travel Card

Note: Fast Track is for foreign passport holders only. Vietnamese passport holders use the autogate system.

Yes. Vietnam's pre-arrival registration (PAI) applies at Cam Ranh to every foreign passenger — including visa-exempt travellers and children, whose parents complete it for them. It's free, done online at prearrival.immigration.gov.vn within the 72 hours before landing, and produces a QR code.

Fast Track does not replace it, but our team will remind you before your flight and help at the counter if anything is missing.

Fast Track Arrival ([caf_price service="fast_track_arrival"]/person) — our assistant meets you inside Terminal 2 on landing, guides you through the priority immigration lane and handles the paperwork. You clear immigration in 10–15 minutes. Baggage Assistance (+$15/person) and VIP Lane (+$20/person) are available as optional add-ons.

Fast Track Departure ([caf_price service="fast_track_departure"]/person) — we meet you at the Terminal 2 departure entrance and guide you through the priority exit immigration lane, so you skip the passport-control queue. Priority Security Screening (+$15/person) can be added.

Yes, a $10 surcharge per person applies for night flights. The windows differ slightly between services:

› Arrivals: between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM
› Departures: between 12:00 AM and 8:00 AM

A large share of flights at Cam Ranh — Russian charters and Korean low-cost services in particular — fall inside these hours. We operate 24/7 regardless of flight time.

Add-ons are priced per person. On arrival:

› Baggage Assistance (+$15) — your agent helps collect and carry your luggage
› VIP Lane (+$20) — a dedicated lane with zero queue

On departure:

› Priority Security Screening (+$15) — dedicated priority security lane

Just let us know when booking and we'll add them to your confirmation.

For arrivals, our assistant waits inside the Terminal 2 international arrival area, holding a sign with your name — before the immigration counters — then guides you through the priority lane, baggage reclaim and customs.

For departures, we meet you at the Terminal 2 departure entrance. We send the exact meeting point after confirmation.

No. Our service fee covers personal assistance only. Official government fees — visa stamping, for example — are paid separately and directly to the authorities on the day of service. We'll always tell you any applicable fees in advance. There's no ATM inside the immigration area, so bring USD or VND if a fee applies to you.

No problem at all. We monitor your flight in real time and adjust accordingly — useful at Cam Ranh, where charter schedules shift often. Our assistant will be there whether your flight lands early, on time, or late.

Yes — the service works for solo travellers, couples, families and larger groups, including tour groups arriving on charter flights. Just tell us the number of passengers when booking. For children:

› Infants under 2 travel free of charge
› Passengers aged 2 and over pay the full price

Families with young children benefit most — no standing in a long queue with kids after an overnight flight. Add Baggage Assistance if you're travelling heavy.

We confirm your booking first — no advance payment required. You can pay online by credit or debit card, or via PayPal (no PayPal account needed); we send a secure payment link after confirmation.

If your card can't be used for international payments — a common situation for guests travelling from Russia and Belarus — tell us when you book and we'll arrange an alternative, such as bank transfer or payment in cash on the day. All options cost the same.

Book directly through the website checkout, or via WhatsApp or email — just send your flight number, date, number of passengers and chosen service. We confirm within 10 minutes, day or night.

Many guests book both arrival and departure for complete peace of mind — start and end your Nha Trang trip hassle-free. Just share both flight details when booking.
